_help: Linux/macOS version (single fixed angle, no paging) — see 3d-model.windows.json for a 10-page turntable version using the same %ANGLE%/paging:"fixed" mechanism, which adapts here too if you want it. Renders 3D models with F3D to a 640x480 PNG with a transparent background, viewed from a fixed angle (35 deg azimuth, 25 deg elevation) so the shape reads in a small thumbnail. --no-config ignores any personal f3d config so thumbnails stay consistent. STEP/IGES need 3d-model-step.json / 3d-model-iges.json instead (f3d can't auto-detect those readers from the extension alone). Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_args: F3D can also read DXF (via assimp), but mostly 3D DXF, not 2D drawings, so dxf is left out here. Remote (sftp://) files can't be read by f3d and fall back to the icon.
